data.name: Darrah
data.gender_notes: Darrah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word ‘durrah’, meaning gardens, orchards, or date palms. This name evokes a sense of beauty, gentleness, and grace, making it an excellent choice for a baby girl. The name Darrah carries the meaning “Gardens, orchards, date palms” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Darrah usually hope their child will grow to embody gardens, orchards, date palms and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Darrah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gardens, orchards, date palms.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Darrah total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

This appreciation for nature is a common thread in Islamic culture, with many hadiths and religious texts emphasizing the importance of preserving and caring for the natural world as a form of worship. In many Islamic communities, gardens play a significant role in both daily life and spiritual practices, serving as places of contemplation, relaxation, and connection with the Divine.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Darrah also carries a spiritual meaning, symbolizing growth, renewal, and nourishment. As a palm tree provides sustenance and shade, the name Darrah reminds us of the importance of nurturing ourselves, our relationships, and our spiritual growth. It also highlights the significance of striving for progress and improvement in our lives, just as a palm tree grows stronger and taller with each passing year. Ultimately, the name Darrah encourages us to cultivate not only beautiful gardens in the physical world, but also in our hearts and minds.
